snapshot_method: Live file copy, with size/mtime stability checked for each file. Not a VSS system image.
limitations: Registry and files are captured sequentially, not as an atomic whole-system snapshot.
Standard ZIP preserves file bytes and timestamps; NTFS ACL metadata is recorded separately. Alternate data streams are not included.
SPSS-referenced shared VC++ DLL files are copied for reference; Windows itself and unrelated shared runtime files are not copied.
The dedicated MCP venv references a shared Python 3.12.14 base runtime; rebuild venv if the base runtime or original paths differ.
License/configuration files are preserved; activation on a different machine is not verified.
Unrelated coursework, videos, account credentials and non-SPSS Codex configuration are outside this backup.
coverage_resolutions: Downloaded Installations\{D22AAA16-CA1D-40A5-B218-D793E1831051} belongs to another product and is excluded.
Generic shared Java/R runtime caches and IBM attach temp files cannot be exclusively attributed to SPSS and are not included.
The former installation source directory G:\temp\{50C00189-8A17-46A6-A05F-33786CE23220} no longer exists; the retained SPSS installer and cached MSI are included.
SafeNet Sentinel shared license state created at SPSS installation time is included; do not overwrite shared license state blindly during restoration.
